title: Verse Enterprises, which wants to provide energy-management software for 100 data centers by 2027, raised a $54M Series B from Nvidia and others (Summer Maxwell/Bloomberg)
summary: Summer Maxwell / Bloomberg: Verse Enterprises, which wants to provide energy-management software for 100 data centers by 2027, raised a $54M Series B from Nvidia and others — Verse Enterprises Inc. is betting batteries and solar can help data centers skip the line. — Long queues to get connected to the strained energy grid …
contentText:
Summer Maxwell / Bloomberg :

Verse Enterprises, which wants to provide energy-management software for 100 data centers by 2027, raised a $54M Series B from Nvidia and others   —  Verse Enterprises Inc. is betting batteries and solar can help data centers skip the line.  —  Long queues to get connected to the strained energy grid …
